description: Browse books that are not part of a series. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

name: books_without_series
